git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add --threshold option to frai eval for quality gates

Enable CI jobs to gate on metric scores with `frai eval --threshold <metric>=<min>`.
Each threshold checks if a metric score >= minimum; exit 1 if any fail, exit 2 for
validation errors. Metrics without scores fail their thresholds (not crash).

Changes:
- frai-core generateReport: accept optional thresholds object, evaluate each, add
  passed/thresholds fields to report (only when thresholds provided)
- Markdown reporter: add Thresholds section showing PASS/FAIL for each threshold
- CLI: parse multiple --threshold flags, validate format and metric IDs, exit codes
- CLI: log threshold results for visibility in CI
- Tests: 5 new tests for threshold passing/failing/missing scores/report formats
- Docs: update README and design doc with threshold feature

Works for default and custom metrics. SDK users can call generateReport with
thresholds directly.
EOF
)"

git add packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts packages/frai-core/README.md docs/eval_harness_design.md

claude.result:
Perfect! The implementation is complete and tested. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

## Feature Implementation: `--threshold` option for `frai eval`

### Core Changes (frai-core)

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`:**
- Modified `generateReport()` to accept optional `thresholds` parameter
- Added `evaluateThresholds()` helper function that checks each threshold against metrics
- Report now includes `passed` (boolean) and `thresholds` (array) fields when thresholds are provided
- Each threshold entry has: `metric`, `min`, `score`, `passed`

**`packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`:**
- Enhanced markdown reports with a new "Thresholds" section
- Shows PASS/FAIL status for each threshold with min/actual scores

### CLI Changes (frai-cli)

**`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`:**
- Added `--threshold <metric=min>` option to `eval` command (supports multiple flags)
- Implemented `parseThresholds()` to validate format and numeric range (0-1)
- Implemented `validateThresholdMetrics()` to verify metric IDs exist
- Updated `runEvalCommand()` to:
  - Exit 2 for malformed thresholds or unknown metrics (with helpful error messages)
  - Exit 1 if any threshold fails
  - Exit 0 if all thresholds pass or no thresholds specified
  - Write report and log threshold results either way

### Tests

Added 5 new tests to `packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`:
- ✅ Thresholds that pass
- ✅ Thresholds that fail
- ✅ Metrics without scores (fail threshold, don't crash)
- ✅ Reports exclude threshold fields when none provided
- ✅ Markdown reports include thresholds section

### Documentation

- Updated `packages/frai-core/README.md` with threshold option details
- Updated `docs/eval_harness_design.md` with Quality Gates section

All new tests are **passing**. The 2 pre-existing test failures (toxicity metric and governance validation) are unrelated and were already failing on main.
